pipeline-auth.title: Pipeline permission roles
pipeline-auth.basis: software permission model, not job descriptions

workforce.title: Workforce ownership and aggregate feed
workforce.basis: adjacent source ownership; HR runtime not inspected

workflow.title: Alamo Workflow procedure and teaching model
workflow.basis: product direction and partial local implementation

care.title: Point of Care active direction
care.basis: planned care workflows; not approved clinical procedures

harness.title: Shared skill harness
harness.basis: local bounded execution and offline improvement

roles.title: Referral / intake coordinator
roles.mission: Turn an incoming referral and its documents into a correctly identified, attributable intake record with missing requirements and the next owner visible.
roles.scope: Authorized referral queue and assigned intake resources; identity matching or visibility never assigns clinical responsibility.
cadence: At intake: establish identity, source and packet inventory.
During queue review: follow unresolved requests and reconcile new documents.
At transfer: record the next responsible owner and outstanding requirements.
knowledge: Person versus referral versus stay identity
Original document, extraction and reviewed fact
Upload/save recovery and private document handling
measures: Time from received referral to recorded intake owner, when both timestamps exist
Missing-requirement age and unresolved identity exceptions; unknown coverage remains explicit
questions: Is intake a dedicated job or shared with assessors/coordinators?
Who may resolve duplicate identities and merge or link records?
Which requirements are mandatory by referral source and facility?

workflows.title: Receive and orient a referral
workflows.trigger: New referral or reopened intake
steps: Inspect the source record and original documents.
Separate known identity from uncertain matches; do not create a second person on a guess.
Prepare an intake summary and record or request the authorized next owner in Pipeline.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A source record with a verified identity decision, document inventory and recorded assignment or explicit unresolved ownership.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Track missing intake information
workflows.trigger: Missing packet item or newly received evidence
steps: Compare received evidence with the current requirements.
Prepare specific requests for missing information without inferring a negative clinical finding.
Have the responsible person record the response and recheck the requirement state.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Requirement resolution is recorded in Pipeline, or an unresolved item retains an accountable owner.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Assessment scheduling / assignment coordinator
roles.mission: Keep assessment work assigned, scheduled and recoverable, while preserving each assessor’s responsibility and source permissions.
roles.scope: Reviewed team/facility assignment and scheduling authority; the software assessment_coordinator permission is not itself a complete job definition.
cadence: Review unassigned and blocked work at the start of the working period.
Reconcile appointment changes and coverage requests as they arrive.
Transfer unfinished coordination explicitly when coverage changes.
measures: Unassigned-case duration with a defined start event
Appointment changes with a recorded next owner or next attempt
questions: Who can reassign across facilities and approve temporary coverage?
Who contacts referral sources and confirms appointments?
What working hours, travel and absence rules apply?

workflows.title: Prepare assignment and coverage review
workflows.trigger: Unassigned work, absence or queue review
steps: Identify unassigned or conflicting ownership from current source facts.
Prepare an assignment proposal and list constraints needing confirmation.
An authorized operator makes the source assignment; verify the recorded owner.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Pipeline confirms the assignment or the coverage exception remains open.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare scheduling and recovery
workflows.trigger: New encounter, cancellation or no-show
steps: Check the latest appointment and required participants.
Prepare options or a recovery checklist without booking or messaging.
The coordinator confirms the source change and records the next attempt when needed.
workflows.sourceOutcome: The source contains the confirmed appointment or an explicit pending/rescheduled/cancelled state.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Assessor
roles.mission: Turn assigned referral evidence into an attributable assessment, explicit recommendation and usable handoff while keeping uncertainty visible.
roles.scope: Current assigned cases and source-authorized evidence. A role blueprint does not authorize another assessor’s case.
cadence: Orient to assigned work and new evidence.
Prepare, conduct and document each assessment using the current questionnaire.
Review, clarify, sign/send through authorized source workflows and follow unresolved handoffs.
knowledge: Interview/app navigation, downtime and review feedback
measures: Supported-answer and unresolved-question rates with reviewed rubrics
Handoff preparation and receiving-acknowledgment gaps, measured separately
questions: Which duties vary by assessor credentials, facility and referral source?
What makes an answer useful beyond mechanical completeness?
What off-app work, travel, follow-up and mentoring belong in this role?

workflows.title: Prepare and review assessment evidence
workflows.trigger: Assigned referral or changed source material
steps: Use the existing assessor preparation procedures and source-checked clickpaths.
Compare supplied answers with evidence and preserve conflicts, dates and unknowns.
Review proposed findings and carry specific unresolved questions into human clarification.
workflows.sourceOutcome: The assessor records attributable answers and resolutions in Pipeline; a saved agent review is not source completion.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare the recommendation and handoff
workflows.trigger: Current assessment is ready for human review
steps: Recheck changed answers and the applicable final-send/correction policy.
Prepare a source-linked handoff; keep recipient and remaining requirements explicit.
The responsible person signs, decides or sends only through the authorized source path; verify delivery and any receiving acknowledgment separately.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source evidence records each required signature/decision/send and, separately, receiving acknowledgment.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Clinical reviewer / admission decision-maker
roles.mission: Make the human judgments and documented decisions assigned to an appropriately qualified reviewer, using attributable assessment evidence and the facility’s approved scope.
roles.scope: Only source-authorized cases and privileges. reviewer is a software role, not evidence of licensure or authority to admit.
cadence: Review cases actually assigned for a decision or consultation.
Request clarification when evidence does not support a decision.
Record the decision and communicate its source-confirmed implications through the responsible handoff.
knowledge: Recommendation versus admission decision versus actual admission
measures: Decision-ready versus clarification-needed cases with explicit reasons
Time awaiting the assigned human decision, excluding unobserved periods
questions: Who owns admission decisions at each site, and under which privileges?
When is clinical review required versus optional consultation?
Which historical supervisor review paths remain applicable?

workflows.title: Prepare evidence for a human decision
workflows.trigger: A decision or consultation is explicitly requested
inputs: Approved site criteria and unresolved items
steps: Verify the correct case, source versions and the reviewer’s authority.
Prepare evidence and questions against supplied approved criteria without deciding suitability.
The qualified reviewer records the decision and rationale through the owning application.
workflows.sourceOutcome: An authorized source decision with rationale and version linkage, or a recorded clarification request.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Review new evidence after a decision
workflows.trigger: Correction or materially changed source evidence
steps: Identify the exact change and preserve the earlier record.
Prepare affected questions and downstream handoff references.
An authorized reviewer determines whether an addendum or new decision is required.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A source-recorded review disposition and any required correction; the prior decision is not silently rewritten.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Admissions / assessment supervisor
roles.mission: Maintain accountable assessment flow across the authorized team, resolve coordination exceptions and prepare evidence-based coaching without treating activity counts as effort.
roles.scope: Authorized team/facility metadata and permitted cases; team access and clinical narrative access are separate.
cadence: Review unowned, overdue, blocked and uncertain-delivery work.
Coordinate coverage and clarification with responsible people.
Review recurring workflow friction and independent fictional training examples.
knowledge: Canonical workflow states and queue limitations
measures: Age of actionable exceptions with complete source history
Receiving-acknowledgment gaps and correction burden; no inferred staff productivity score
questions: Which exceptions require same-period review and who defines the due rules?
What can supervisors see in assessment content versus metadata?
Who can approve coverage and who owns coaching?

workflows.title: Review team exceptions
workflows.trigger: Queue review or a source-confirmed exception
steps: Check coverage and freshness before interpreting counts.
Prepare exceptions, evidence and the human verification needed.
Assign follow-up through the permitted source workflow and verify its state.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source-owned follow-up or explicit unresolved ownership; the brief itself does not resolve the exception.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare coaching and process feedback
workflows.trigger: Repeated clarification or handoff friction
steps: Separate source facts from interpretation and missing observations.
Prepare a specific process question or training example.
Have the responsible reviewer decide what guidance or process should change.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Reviewed feedback linked to evidence, with publication/skill changes left to the authorized owners.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Admission / transition coordinator
roles.mission: Carry the accepted referral into a receiving-team handoff with clear identity, dates, requirements and acknowledgment, without equating an accepted decision with actual admission.
roles.scope: Authorized sending and receiving resources; cross-app identity and recipient access must be verified separately.
cadence: Review accepted or transitioning cases and missing dates.
Reconcile sending and receiving evidence as it changes.
Close only the responsibilities supported by source receipts.
knowledge: Acceptance, scheduled arrival, actual admission and stay identity
measures: Transitions with a known receiving owner and current readiness evidence
Time from recorded send to required receiving acknowledgment where observable
questions: Which team owns the transition after the assessment is sent?
What constitutes accepted receiving acknowledgment?
Which data must be reverified in Point of Care before becoming care facts?

workflows.title: Review transition readiness
workflows.trigger: Accepted referral or changed arrival plan
steps: Compare current requirements with source-confirmed completion.
Prepare a handoff checklist and name unknowns without declaring readiness from missing data.
The receiving owner verifies and records acceptance through the appropriate source.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source-owned readiness/acceptance and outstanding requirements remain distinguishable.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Reconcile failed or uncertain handoff
workflows.trigger: A send fails, is uncertain or lacks acknowledgment
steps: Compare the exact attempt with the current source record.
Prepare a verification or retry recommendation without sending.
A human reconciles the source result and receiving acknowledgment.
workflows.sourceOutcome: The source records the reconciled delivery/receipt state or an accountable unresolved exception.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Direct-care staff
roles.mission: Carry out assigned, approved care work and document what was observed, performed and still unresolved within the person’s actual authorization and training.
roles.scope: Current facility/shift/resident assignments and approved care privileges. No eMAR, prescribing or inferred clinical authority.
cadence: At handoff: verify assigned residents and open care work.
During care: follow approved procedures and record actual observations/actions or exceptions.
At transfer: preserve outstanding response review and receiving ownership.
knowledge: Resident identity and approved care plan version
measures: Assigned obligations with attributable source outcomes or exceptions
Handoffs carrying unresolved care work; not task counts as quality of care
questions: What are the actual direct-care titles and approved activities at each site?
Which observations or notes require review or a second signature?
What off-app duties and downtime procedures must be represented?

workflows.title: Orient to assigned care work
workflows.trigger: Shift start or reassignment
steps: Verify person, place, assignment and current plan.
Review the source-owned obligations and unresolved information.
Seek the responsible human clarification when the plan, authority or ownership is unclear.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A source-confirmed assignment and reviewed handoff context; viewing a brief does not attest care occurred.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare documentation and carry forward work
workflows.trigger: A care interaction or observation has occurred
steps: Separate observed facts from reported information and inference.
Prepare a draft only from supplied facts; do not invent performance or response.
The authorized staff member verifies, records/signs and hands unresolved work to the next owner.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Authorized source documentation and explicit outstanding obligations; draft acceptance alone is not a clinical signature.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Shift / house supervisor
roles.mission: Keep assigned care work covered and preserve unresolved responsibilities across staff and shift changes.
roles.scope: Reviewed house/facility/shift scope, with clinical and HR details limited by their independent source grants.
cadence: At shift opening: reconcile coverage and unresolved handoff items.
During the shift: route care-work exceptions to the appropriate authorized owner.
At shift close: verify transfer of open commitments.
knowledge: Care versus staffing versus analytical records
measures: Unowned care obligations with known source coverage
Open commitments transferred with explicit receiving acknowledgment
questions: Is shift/house supervision a distinct role at every community?
Who can change assignments and who can provide qualified clinical review?
Which source proves a receiving shift accepted responsibility?

workflows.title: Review work and coverage exceptions
workflows.trigger: Shift start, absence or new unowned work
steps: Check whether the source evidence is current and complete.
Prepare an exception list separating coverage from clinical decisions.
The authorized supervisor records assignments or routes the question to the appropriate owner.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source-recorded coverage or an accountable unresolved exception.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare the next-shift handoff
workflows.trigger: Shift change or transfer of responsibility
steps: Assemble only the authorized unresolved commitments and evidence.
Name unknown receiving ownership and outstanding response review.
The responsible people confirm the transfer in the source workflow.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Required receiving acknowledgment and source assignment change, or an explicit unresolved handoff.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Qualified clinical / care-plan lead
roles.mission: Own the clinical review, care-plan interpretation and response decisions assigned by the facility’s approved scope and the person’s verified privileges.
roles.scope: Credential- and privilege-appropriate resources and decisions; actual titles and scope require local confirmation.
cadence: Review assigned new information and outstanding response reviews.
Maintain authorized care-plan decisions and attributable documentation.
Prepare clear follow-through for staff and the next qualified reviewer.
knowledge: Approved facility scope and care policy
Plan versions, provenance and clinical signatures
Transition evidence versus accepted clinical facts
measures: Assigned response reviews with source-recorded dispositions
Care-plan changes with linked evidence and downstream review needs
questions: Which disciplines actually hold these responsibilities in each community?
Who owns care-plan approval and response review?
Which source policies define thresholds and escalation timing?

workflows.title: Prepare a response review
workflows.trigger: Assigned response review or changed observation
steps: Check dates, attribution and current plan version.
Prepare the observed change and unresolved evidence for a qualified person.
The qualified reviewer determines and records the disposition; the agent does not prescribe an intervention.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A source-recorded human review/disposition linked to the correct observations and plan.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Review impact of a care-plan change
workflows.trigger: An authorized plan revision is recorded
steps: Identify the exact changed source references.
Prepare impacted obligations and guidance for review without replacing signed records.
The authorized owners confirm changes and hand off affected work.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source-approved plan/obligation changes and reviewed guidance references.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Community / Executive Director
roles.mission: Maintain facility-level operational oversight, licensing follow-through and accountable cross-team coordination within assigned communities.
roles.scope: Assigned communities only; the Executive Director workspace is distinct from unrestricted Platform, assessment, HR and clinical access.
cadence: Review current community context and actionable gaps.
Follow licensing/reporting work and cross-team ownership.
Review source-backed exceptions and outstanding commitments with the responsible owners.
knowledge: Incident/report status and original source records
Reporting and escalation rules supplied by approved policy
measures: Owned exceptions with source-confirmed follow-through
Report readiness and delivery states; timeliness only against reviewed applicable due rules
questions: Which licensing/report duties belong to the director versus a specialist?
Who can approve, file and acknowledge each report?
Which meetings, staffing and facility duties happen outside these apps?

workflows.title: Review community operations
workflows.trigger: Regular review or a scoped exception
steps: Verify the community, period and dataset coverage.
Prepare a concise brief with source links and known gaps.
Route follow-up to a responsible owner and verify source-recorded progress.
workflows.sourceOutcome: An owned follow-up or explicit unresolved exception, not merely a read dashboard.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Review licensing/report preparation
workflows.trigger: New report draft or state report change
steps: Inspect originals and preserve facts, attribution and uncertainty.
Review proposed language or follow-up requirements against approved policy.
An authorized person records review and performs any filing or delivery outside the agent.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source review, save, filing and delivery evidence are separate; unknown states remain unknown.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Licensing / compliance owner
roles.mission: Maintain traceable licensing evidence, report preparation and applicable follow-up without replacing official source documents or inventing reporting rules.
roles.scope: Authorized facilities and reports; reporting authority and external communication approval must be separately established.
cadence: Review changed state reports and source collection gaps.
Prepare evidence and language review for authorized staff.
Maintain owned follow-ups and procedure changes after review.
knowledge: Original versus extracted and summarized text
measures: Findings with current source citations and accountable follow-up
Report corrections and missing-evidence rates; no universal deadline assumption
questions: Is there a dedicated compliance role or does each director own this?
What reviewed rules apply to each facility and report category?
Who confirms filing, delivery and subsequent follow-up?

workflows.title: Review source licensing changes
workflows.trigger: New or changed state report
steps: Compare exact versions and identify substantive changes.
Prepare a readable summary with citations and uncertainty.
Have the responsible owner review the finding and record an assigned follow-up.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A reviewed finding linked to its original and an owned follow-up, without implied filing.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare fact-preserving report language
workflows.trigger: Native LIC 624 draft or backlog scan review
steps: Separate extracted text from verified human facts.
Propose wording changes with a difference view and unresolved questions.
A human confirms the exact version before the owning app saves; filing is a separate action.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source-confirmed accepted revision; any filing/delivery needs its own evidence.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Executive / operations leader
roles.mission: Understand governed organization trends and material exceptions, choose accountable follow-up and evaluate whether the software improves work.
roles.scope: Explicitly authorized portfolio/aggregate views; organization-wide analysis never grants individual clinical, employee or conversation access.
cadence: Review defined operational measures and material exceptions.
Assign accountable investigation through existing governance.
Review business outcomes and product/skill evidence before expansion.
knowledge: Cohorts, denominators, time windows and missing data
Verified outcome versus activity and draft counts
measures: Workflow measures with documented denominator, freshness and coverage
Verified useful outcomes and review burden; no unsupported staff ranking
questions: Which decisions should recurring executive briefs support?
Which thresholds, recipients and channels are approved for exception alerts?
What outcome/cost evidence is required before expanding agent authority?

workflows.title: Review aggregate trends
workflows.trigger: Defined operating review or requested comparison
steps: Check comparable periods and complete source definitions.
Prepare the measures and limitations without exposing raw records or inventing causes.
Choose a scoped investigation and responsible human owner.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A recorded decision/follow-up with authorized evidence; a trend explanation is not causal proof.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Review a proposed exception
workflows.trigger: An approved trigger is met or a human requests investigation
steps: Check that the rule, source scope and current evidence are available.
Prepare the reason, uncertainty and proposed next human action.
A person decides whether/how to notify or act; all email remains disabled.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A reviewed disposition with source evidence; drafts are not delivered alerts.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Workforce / HR operations coordinator
roles.mission: Coordinate staffing, credential and hiring follow-through through the authoritative Workforce application, using Platform only for its permitted aggregate overview.
roles.scope: HR/workforce source permissions are independent of Platform aggregates or resident-care permissions; no personal HR connector is enabled.
cadence: Review authorized coverage/credential exceptions and open positions.
Coordinate source-recorded next actions with community owners.
Maintain reviewed role and onboarding requirements.
measures: Coverage exceptions with an assigned source owner
Age of open-role next actions and missing credential evidence, within approved HR policy
questions: Which roles own scheduling, recruiting, credentials and employee onboarding?
Which Workforce states actually block scheduling, and who can resolve them?
Which staff records can each community director see?

workflows.title: Review staffing and credential gaps
workflows.trigger: Authorized workforce review or source change
steps: Check scope and freshness; keep names/details out of aggregate-only views.
Prepare the reported coverage gaps without making fitness or hiring decisions.
The authorized Workforce operator verifies and records the next action.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Workforce records the disposition; Platform counts and agent drafts do not modify staff status.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare role onboarding requirements
workflows.trigger: A role begins or approved duties change
steps: Confirm the actual job and scope rather than copying a software permission label.
Prepare applicable learning and unresolved credential/assignment questions.
Authorized owners record employment, access and learning decisions separately.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Separate source evidence for employment assignment, granted access and learning; none substitutes for another.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Procedure / training owner
roles.mission: Turn reviewed work knowledge into current procedures, walkthroughs, practice and feedback while keeping guidance aligned with source app behavior.
roles.scope: Authorized knowledge and teaching content; drafting guidance does not grant publication authority or access to employee private conversations.
cadence: Review source/policy changes affecting guidance.
Prepare and review procedures and fictional practice cases.
Collect explicit feedback and keep teaching versions aligned with app/task versions.
knowledge: Procedure versus policy versus observed habit
measures: Approved tasks with current source-checked guidance
Learner/reviewer correction burden and stale-guidance gaps; completion is not competence
questions: Who approves procedures and clinical/legal content for each domain?
Where are authoritative policy versions and learning records stored?
Who may publish or retire guidance, and how are affected users informed?

workflows.title: Draft or revise a procedure
workflows.trigger: New work family or documented source change
steps: Separate required policy from observed practice and inferred gaps.
Draft purpose, prerequisites, branches, evidence and human decisions; use only verified clickpaths.
Route the version to its domain owner and preserve the previous published version.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A reviewed published procedure version in its owning source; a draft or common habit is not policy.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare teaching and isolated practice
workflows.trigger: New hire, refresher or identified learning need
steps: Match the learning task to the current role and app version.
Prepare explanations, walkthroughs and fictional practice with visible recovery branches.
Record actual reviewer feedback separately from tutorial completion and competence decisions.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Versioned learning evidence and human feedback; no real record change or automatic grant.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Data / operational quality analyst
roles.mission: Make business measures and cross-app evidence interpretable, traceable and scoped, while identifying gaps before they become confident operational claims.
roles.scope: Approved datasets and metadata; analytical access does not confer source transaction rights or unrestricted person-level access.
cadence: Check freshness and coverage before analysis.
Investigate source/projection differences and identity ambiguities.
Review metric definitions, source changes and proposed mappings with business owners.
knowledge: Source of truth and effective time
measures: Known coverage and freshness against reviewed source expectations
Unresolved mapping/lineage exceptions and reconciliation differences
questions: Who owns each metric and cross-application identity mapping?
Which completeness and freshness targets are valid per dataset?
What aggregate disclosure and drill-down policy applies?

workflows.title: Investigate data or measure differences
workflows.trigger: Missing/stale feed or conflicting measures
steps: Check time, scope, grain and completeness before comparing values.
Trace the difference to the source and transformation references.
Prepare a correction or definition question for the owning system; never silently patch clinical truth.
workflows.sourceOutcome: An owned source/definition disposition and a subsequently reconciled governed view.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Prepare an ontology or identity mapping
workflows.trigger: New source or changed schema
steps: Identify what each source object actually means and who owns it.
Propose relationships with evidence and validity periods; leave ambiguous identities unresolved.
Business/source owners review the mapping before activation or downstream use.
workflows.sourceOutcome: A reviewed versioned mapping; proposal acceptance does not grant new data access.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

roles.title: Application / integration administrator
roles.mission: Operate source integrations, permissions, releases and recovery while preserving each application’s authority and auditable change process.
roles.scope: Explicit administrative duties and workload permissions; technical access is not a clinical signature, HR decision or general agent grant.
cadence: Review integration health and failed work.
Prepare source, policy and release changes with compatibility evidence.
Reconcile outages and recovery before expanding enabled capabilities.
measures: Verified integration readiness and recoverable failures
Recovery/reconciliation outcomes and unclosed access/coverage gaps
questions: Who owns the independent agent remote, CI and production release?
Who owns the shared foundation serving and publication identities?
Which approval, incident and recovery processes already govern these apps?

workflows.title: Prepare application/capability onboarding
workflows.trigger: New integration or proposed source capability
steps: Inventory what exists, is configured and is actually authorized separately.
Prepare missing contracts, mappings and controlled test evidence.
The owning operators approve configuration and release through the actual process; a catalog entry cannot activate itself.
workflows.sourceOutcome: An explicitly reviewed integration with independently verified access/readiness, or a named unmet prerequisite.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

workflows.title: Investigate and recover incomplete work
workflows.trigger: Failure, retry uncertainty or release regression
steps: Distinguish failed, pending and uncertain outcomes before retrying.
Prepare a bounded recovery and verification plan without bypassing source preconditions.
The authorized operator performs recovery and verifies source state and rollback compatibility.
workflows.sourceOutcome: Source-confirmed reconciliation or an accountable unresolved incident; successful execution alone is insufficient.
workflows.exception: Stop at missing authority, ambiguous ownership or stale evidence; retain the open item and its source references.

openCoverage: Finance/revenue-cycle duties and actual application ownership
Facilities, transport, food service, housekeeping and other off-app work
External clinicians, referral partners and other non-employee actors
Site-specific clinical disciplines, credentials and reporting authority
Actual employee roster, role combinations, coverage and effective dates
Approved working cadences, due rules and escalation contacts
commonBoundaries: Role descriptions are inferred job blueprints, not approved job descriptions, actual employee dossiers or access grants.
Source-supported means the app/document supports the workflow; it does not establish which person or title owns it.
Read, investigate and draft; source actions and exact-version approvals remain separate.
Eric-only pilot; no emails; no real assessment reads or changes; no production activation.
No clinical judgment, treatment thresholds, legal deadlines or credential requirements are invented.
Expected duties, observed work, inferred patterns, reviewed learning and demonstrated competence remain distinct.
A learning completion, accepted draft, source command receipt and verified business outcome are different facts.
Private conversations are not automatically workforce or management data.
Existing 17 assessor procedures/workflows remain linked; this catalog neither duplicates their clickpaths nor activates them.
